headline: Weathered Expanse Reignites in Fierce Clashes as Stonecradle Churn Persists
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has erupted into fresh base exchanges over the past two hours, with violent clashes sweeping Crow's Nest and Frostmarch as casualty rates surge on both sides. In Stonecradle, contested fighting persists across World's End and The Reach, yielding further base shifts and sustaining pressure across the sector. Mooring County has recorded no new strategic base transfers during the latest two hours, yet intense combat continues alongside accelerating enlistment rates and severe frontline casualties. Heavy attrition remains unyielding in Callahan's Passage, where losses mount steadily along fortified positions without immediate territorial change, while Farranac Coast registers a sharp acceleration in butcher bills. Farther afield, earlier active sectors including Fishermans Row, Linn of Mercy, and Stlican Shelf have settled into quieter vigils following previous shifts, concentrating the war's primary momentum along the contested northern and central axes.
